website.label: Website / portfolio
website.pass: A valid http(s) website field is present; availability is not verified.
website.fail: The website field is empty; no valid http(s) link was found.

profileReadme.label: Profile README
profileReadme.pass: A non-empty profile README is present.

description.label: Repository description
description.pass: A non-empty repository description is present.

topics.label: At least one topic
topics.pass: Frontend and web topics are present in the sample metadata.

demo.label: Labelled demo link
demo.pass: The README includes a labelled live demo link. Its availability was not verified.
demo.fail: No labelled demo link appears in the README sample; the homepage field is also empty.

image.label: Screenshot / image
image.pass: The sample README AST contains an image reference; loading was not verified.
image.fail: No image reference was found in the sample README AST.

readme.label: Non-empty README
readme.pass: The README exists and is not empty.

purpose.label: Project purpose
purpose.pass: A purpose heading is followed by an explanatory paragraph.
purpose.fail: No purpose section with an explanatory paragraph was found.

install.label: Installation steps
install.pass: The installation section contains an npm install command block.
install.fail: An installation heading exists, but the section has no command or code block.

usage.label: Run / usage
usage.pass: The usage section contains an npm run dev command and an explanation.
usage.fail: No run or usage section was found.

technology.label: Technologies
technology.pass: A list appears under the technologies heading.
technology.fail: No technologies section with content was found.

features.label: Features
features.pass: A list appears under the features heading.
features.fail: No features section with content was found.
